Name: Hold the Line
Effect: Every enemy single-target move this round is drawn to you. Area moves are not redirected.

Name: Iron Bulwark
Effect: Every enemy single-target move this round is drawn to you, and your Defense rises 10% for the rest of the battle.

Name: Martyr's Aegis
Effect: Every enemy single-target move this round is drawn to you, your Defense rises 10% for the rest of the battle, and you heal 5% of maximum HP for each hit you take this round.

Name: Blood Price
Effect: This round every hit you take is answered with a 50 power counter, and each hit raises your Attack 4% for the rest of the battle, up to +40%.

Name: Tyrant's Toll
Effect: This round every hit you take is answered with a 65 power counter, and each hit raises your Attack 5% for the rest of the battle, up to +50%.

Name: Wrath of the Pit
Effect: This round every hit you take is answered with an 80 power counter, and each hit raises your Attack 6% for the rest of the battle, up to +60%.

Name: Recitation
Effect: Every support ability you have slotted fires at once across the whole party at 40% magnitude and half duration.

Name: Grand Thesis
Effect: Every support ability you have slotted fires at once across the whole party at 50% magnitude and half duration.

Name: Revelation
Effect: Every support ability you have slotted fires at once across the whole party at 60% magnitude and half duration.

Name: Slip Away
Effect: You cannot be targeted by single-target moves for 1 round. Area moves still connect and existing effects keep ticking.

Name: Shadowmeld
Effect: You cannot be targeted by single-target moves for 2 rounds. Area moves still connect and existing effects keep ticking.

Name: Vanish
Effect: You cannot be targeted by single-target moves for 3 rounds. Area moves still connect and existing effects keep ticking.
